text: This report presents the City of Toronto's Consolidated Trust Funds Financial Statements for the year ended December 31, 2017 to Committee and City Council for approval, and provides highlights of the Trust Funds' 2017 financial performance and financial condition as of December 31, 2017.

City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the 2017 Trust Fund Statements as attached in Appendix A of the report (June 26, 2018) from the Treasurer.
